549-5147-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5147-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
549-5147-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

1395-5078-6633-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

465-728-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

620-2111-2981.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-4153-4186--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

Repeat.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {1}.

2533-2719-6913.description:

Repeat.

2085-4359-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1698-3260-3540-7056.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-7056.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-7056.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

3617-5626-6991.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
3617-5626-6991.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
3617-5626-6991.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Donnie & April from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Donnie & April, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2511-3564-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
2511-3564-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-3564-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1809-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1809-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and Peregrine Drake
When Returned Pastcaller and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1809-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability

5175-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
5175-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
5175-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

4863-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Revolutionist.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
4863-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Revolutionist, causing you to mill cards equal to Revolutionist's power.
Cast Revolutionist from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to return Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.

Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

3259-4359-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

719-969-3259-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
719-969-3259-4302.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Thunderous Debut.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Naru Meha on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the copy of Thunderous Debut, causing you to look at the top twenty cards of your library and put Naru Meha and up to one other creature card onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

880-3703-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3703-4871.description:

When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3179-3263-3676-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {1}.
Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
